observation_summary: The compiler incorrectly removes assignments in expressions like '((x=p.id) && ...)', treating the assignment as dead even though 'x' is used later in the expression. The fix adds a check to ensure the variable is not read in the RHS before marking it as a kill.
hypothesis: The DeadAssignmentsElimination pass incorrectly identifies an assignment as 'dead' and removes it, even when the assigned variable is subsequently read within the same expression (e.g., in an AND chain). The logic fails to check if the RHS of an assignment contains a read of the variable being assigned on the LHS.
prediction: The fix will involve adding a check in DeadAssignmentsElimination to verify if the variable is read in the RHS of an assignment before marking it as a KILL, preventing premature removal of the assignment.
experiment_rationale: The provided fix diff clearly shows the addition of a check (isVariableReadBeforeKill) in the DeadAssignmentsElimination class, which confirms the algorithm was missing a necessary check for variable liveness within the RHS of an assignment.
reasoning_summary: The bug report and the provided fix diff confirm that the DeadAssignmentsElimination pass was incorrectly removing assignments. This is a procedural logic error in the optimization pass, fitting the Algorithm/Method category.
